heroHeadline: AFP Documents 35 Chinese Vessels — 15 PLAN Warships + 20 CCG — at Four WPS Locations Post-Balikatan; Scarborough Shoal Has Heaviest Ever Recorded Military Concentration (8 PLAN + 9 CCG) — Reed Bank Standoff Day 7, Marine Reserve Dispute Unresolved
heroSubtitle: AFP's post-Balikatan 41-2026 West Philippine Sea monitoring report (May 13, 2026) documents 35 Chinese vessels — 15 People's Liberation Army Navy warships and 20 China Coast Guard cutters — at four strategic WPS locations during the May 4-11 monitoring window: Scarborough Shoal (8 PLAN warships + 9 CCG cutters, highest concentration), Pag-asa Island/Thitu (3 PLAN + 3 CCG), Escoda/Sabina Shoal (3 PLAN + 2 CCG), and Ayungin/Second Thomas Shoal (1 PLAN + 6 CCG). The 8 PLAN warships and 9 CCG cutters concentrated at Scarborough Shoal constitute the largest combined China military presence at that location in official AFP public records — deployed simultaneously with China's unresolved 'marine nature reserve' institutional claim (DFA protest May 11, no Chinese response), the April 2026 floating barrier, and the CCG Chuanshan rights-safeguarding training (May 9). Despite this 35-vessel footprint throughout the 19-day Balikatan 41-2026 exercise (17,000+ troops, 7 partner nations), AFP confirmed no coercive or aggressive Chinese actions during the entire exercise period — consistent with China's 'shadow exercise' doctrine of maintaining maximum visible presence without triggering US Mutual Defense Treaty activation. China Embassy Manila conducted a parallel information operations campaign May 9-10, posting cartoons recasting documented water cannon attacks on Filipino fishermen as 'helpful at sea.' The Reed Bank standoff enters Day 7 on May 13 as China's research vessel Xiang Yang Hong 33 continues operations near Iroquois Reef with Beijing still offering no response to the Philippines' May 11 UNCLOS Article 246 note verbale. Three concurrent SCS confrontations persist: Reed Bank (research vessel standoff, Day 7), Second Thomas Shoal (BRP Sierra Madre garrison, ongoing), and Scarborough Shoal (floating barrier + marine nature reserve + peak PLAN/CCG presence). AFP's 35-vessel figure is the most comprehensive single-period public snapshot of China's WPS military footprint under the Marcos administration's transparency campaign, providing unprecedented public granularity on China's post-Balikatan deterrence posture across all active confrontation fronts.
